name: cordon
description: Malicious packages, install-time behaviour, AI agent files, skills and MCP servers, secrets and vulnerable dependencies, shown in the editor -- and Cordon's checks offered to the editor's AI agents over MCP. Runs the cordon-scanner you installed; sends nothing anywhere.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Cordon runs a scanner process over the workspace; it waits until you trust the folder.

cordon.path.description: The cordon-scanner executable. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot choose what the extension runs.

cordon.scanOnSave.description: Rescan when a file is saved.

cordon.minimumSeverity.description: Findings below this severity are not shown.

cordon.mcp.enabled.description: Offer Cordon's MCP server to this editor's AI agents (VS Code 1.101 and later): they can check packages, install commands, skills, MCP servers and agent files before acting.

cordon.mcp.allowOnline.description: Let the MCP server's tools ask registries and fetch packages, images and extensions to scan them. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot turn the network on.
